subject: Cloud review of #1224-#1228: two need fixes (#1224, #1225), three ship
body:
Reviewed read-only in separate worktrees; each finding was reproduced on the branch.

#1224 core-evidence-freshness (DECISION_PATH, owner merges) - FIX NEEDED.
HIGH evidence.ts:394: the not-fresh fold is order-dependent. resolveWorst replaces a reading only on strictly greater severity, and suspected and confirmed both score 2. With suspected@14:00Z stale (conn a), confirmed@14:30Z stale (conn b) and none@2099 unknown (conn c), the order [sus, con, none] gives restrict while [con, sus, none] gives deny. Adding a not-fresh reading still loosens the verdict. Fix: push older readings newest-first (observedAt descending) and add the three-reading case to the proof.
MEDIUM store.ts:306: on a single dock connector, a future-stamped none still overwrites a fresh confirmed in putSignal. Measured with runDockSync at 15:00 (confirmed@14:55Z) then 15:05 (none@2099): the store holds only the none row and the verdict is step_up instead of deny. Base behaves the same, so this is not a regression, but the claim is wider than the code. Either narrow the claim to cross-connector readings, or keep the prior fresh row when the incoming one is unknown or expired.
NIT: CLAIM_INVENTORY rows 17, 19 and 48 still anchor on evidence.ts:573, which is now LOCAL_AUTHORITY_STATES; the raise-only sentence is at :626.
Green on the branch: proof:signalgrid-core 619, test:api 486/486, typecheck, review:invariants, normalization --check, doc figures, manifest --check, room-console rebuild byte-identical.

#1225 sim-scripts-bash32-darwin (SAFETY_MACHINERY) - FIX NEEDED.
MEDIUM check-sim-scripts-selfcheck.mjs:420: rule (g) accepts ${A:+"${A[@]}"}, and G32_CASES pins it as passing. With A=("" x y) that form expands to nothing, so data is lost. Stop accepting :+ and flip that case to expect 1; CLAUDE.md prescribes only ${A+"${A[@]}"}.
MEDIUM :389: shellCode strips everything after ' #', even inside quotes. A planted X=(); echo "note #1 ${X[@]}" in resume-lane.sh passed the gate. Strip comments only outside quotes, and add that case to the self-test.

#1226 restore-archive-precheck (SAFETY_MACHINERY) - SHIP. NIT backup.ts:236: a pg_restore --list that exits 0 with nothing parseable passes the shape check; refusing an empty TOC would be fail-closed. Its gating run failed only in the mainline workflow streak check (401 on GET /actions/workflows, an API read failure, not this diff); cloud commented on the PR and re-ran the job once.

#1227 preflight-verdict-guards (SAFETY_MACHINERY) - SHIP. NIT check-preflight-ci-parity.mjs:287: unguardedDiffSteps checks that a guard exists, not that it runs before the diff. Every wrong case fails closed.

#1228 api-profile-stepup-estate (DECISION_PATH, owner merges) - SHIP. MEDIUM docs: the five BUILD_BACKLOG rows this PR fixes (near :2512) are still marked open; mark them. NIT, pre-existing: in complete-step-up (v1.ts:848), parseEvaluate/core.evaluate still run after verifyAuthentication, so a failure there still uses up the challenge. Also: #1228 conflicts with cloud #1215 (row 97) on artifacts/api-server/src/lib/profile.ts. Whichever the owner merges second needs SignalGrid_Alpha merged in; cloud will do that for #1215.

To land #1225/#1226/#1227: once they are fixed and green, send a land ask by mail and cloud merges on the gating check. #1224/#1228 are the owner's.
